    BookNotFoundException
    Thrown when an operation refers to a book ID that is not in the library, for example updating or deleting a book that does not exist.
    DuplicateBookException
    Thrown when a book is added with an ID that already exists in the library.
    LibraryException
    Base class for every error the library system reports to the user.
    ValidationException
    Thrown when user input is not acceptable, for example an empty title, an empty author or an empty book ID.
